document: HES Trade Agent Promotion Contract v1
purpose: Define pre-registered evidence gates for any future Promotion Candidate decision. This contract does not promote, tune, delete, or reselection winners.

gates.requirement: Exact lineage/reconciliation must remain reproducible from immutable raw blobs and frozen protocol.
Evidence must survive dependence/concentration stress; the current conservative proxy (~3.97) is descriptive only and is not sufficient by itself.
LONG and SHORT evidence must remain positive/sign-consistent across locked lineages without post-hoc selection.
Range and Uptrend evidence currently sign-consistent; Downtrend evidence must be established before any broad up/down-trend robustness claim.
Performance must not depend materially on a single fold; fixed LOFO and top-fold exclusion stress must remain acceptable under a pre-registered criterion.
A genuinely forward, untouched evaluation period must be defined before inspection and then evaluated without threshold/winner changes.
No promotion claim may generalize beyond observed direction/regime coverage; missing cells must be explicitly resolved by future data.
Collector/data pipeline, single-writer/checkpoint lineage, and artifact integrity must remain healthy during the evaluation period.

non_negotiable_invariants: No threshold tuning after seeing evaluation outcomes.
No promotion based on nominal n alone.
No causal or predictive-validity claim from retrospective evidence alone.
No live execution authorization from this contract.
Secrets remain outside source, artifacts, logs, and datasets.
